text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One key area is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP also makes translation possible, so tools can quickly change text from one language into another. Another useful feature is sentiment analysis, which helps computers recognise whether a message is positive, negative, or neutral. You probably use NLP every day through chatbots, which answer questions and give support online. Thanks to NLP, technology is becoming better at communicating with people in a natural and helpful way.
